content: The SWS Compiler Abstraction is applicable for each AUTOSAR basic software module and application software components. Therefore, the implementation of the memory class (memclass) and pointer class (ptrclass) macro parameters (see SWS_COMPILER_00040 ) shall fu lfill the implementation and configuration specific needs of each software module in a specific build scenario.
